name: cli-exit-code
prompt: Our CI pipeline runs `node bin/validate-config.js <file>` but it never fails the build, because the script always exits with code 0. Fix the CLI: print "OK" to stdout and exit 0 when the file is valid; when the file's content is invalid (not JSON, or validate() reports problems) print each problem to stderr and exit 1; when the argument is missing or the file can't be read, print a usage or read error to stderr and exit 2. Nothing should be printed to stdout in the error cases.
